verdicts.why: Wikipedia's plot has Loki enslave Barton with the scepter at the Tesseract facility before Fury reactivates the Avengers Initiative and Romanoff recruits Banner, so Clint is not recruited when Loki attacks; he is freed on the Helicarrier and fights with the team in New York.

The Attack on the Helicarrier page has Romanoff hit Barton hard enough to break his brainwashing before Loki tricks Thor into the cell and stabs Coulson, so Clint is no longer under control when Coulson dies, while the proposed lines (Clint leads the attack, Coulson dies during Loki's escape) are true.

When Loki interrupts the Grandmaster, Topaz offers the Melt Stick to destroy him and the Grandmaster says interrupting is not a capital crime; Topaz later chases only the Commodore carrying Thor, Banner and Valkyrie, so she never works with or hunts Loki and ally does not fit.

proposed.text: Madani tracks Curtis to the RV where he is looking after Amy Bendix and presses him to give up Frank. He says he does not know where Frank is, and they end up sharing a drink.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who tracks Curtis to the RV and presses him to give up Frank.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Frank's friend, looking after Amy when Madani tracks him down.

verdicts.why: The proposed events are right for S2#8 (Madani tracks Hoyle's phone, finds him with Amy, offers to help if they give up Castle and Russo, Hoyle does not know where Castle is, and they all drink), but the hideout is an RV in a junkyard (the Campervan Hideout), not a trailer.

In Yucca Valley (#8), Trevor as the Mandarin claims the set explosion in a recording sent to multiple news outlets, not on live TV, and the DODC raids the Talmadge, where Cleary tells him he can take the fall, and sends him to the DODC Supermax Prison.

In The Evil Within (#6), Charlotte, the head of Chthon, makes her first appearance and confronts Marcus about Aurora; she asks Chase to keep an eye on Marcus only in #11, and his plot against the purebloods is uncovered in #10.
Saint's men kill the whole family at the reunion, but Maria and Will flee in a jeep and are run down by John Saint's truck, so 'gunned down' is wrong and 'killed' is right.

In #54, Keene Marlow visits May, who introduces him to Peter as an old friend of Ben's; the Destroyer is first shown in #56 (Secrets of the Six), so 'secretly the Destroyer' gives away a later reveal.

In #59 Peter and Mary Jane reach Niagara Falls for their postponed honeymoon and Hydro-Man takes her; in #60 she is revealed as Miles Warren's unstable clone and dies, and Madame Web offers to take Peter to find Mary Jane, so the reveal comes on the honeymoon, not after it.

In Identity Crisis (#20), Venom nearly unmasks Spider-Man in public and tries to force-feed him the stolen gene cleanser, Spider-Man shoves it down Venom's mouth so the symbiote leaves Eddie, and Eddie is wheeled to an ambulance promising revenge; going after Peter's loved ones is #13, and no source sends Eddie to Ravencroft here.

proposed.title: The Spectacular Spider-Man#7
proposed.text: Norman is Harry's cold, ruthless father, and Spider-Man saves him from the Vulture. Meanwhile a masked Green Goblin sets out to take over New York's underworld from the Big Man and tries to kill Spider-Man.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The hero who saves Norman from the Vulture.

verdicts.why: The Goblin's first appearance is #7 (Catalysts), where he tries to replace the Big Man and kill Spider-Man, but at #7 he does not play the crime bosses against each other: that is revealed in Season 2's Gangland. The line on b's card ('Norman torments as the Goblin') gives away the #26 unmasking, and at #9 the show points to Harry as the Goblin.
In Hero or Menace (#9), Norman gloats in jail that he tipped off Ross and that Oscorp is seizing Otto's inventions, and Otto lashes out at him for exploiting others' work; the plot has no vow.
In #10 Jeanne is revealed as Finesse, Daredevil's partner, who took the Oscorp internship to spy on Osborn for him, and Daredevil suggests she accept Harry's W.E.B. invite and keep an eye on Harry.
